// Synthetic gin routes fixture; .txt prevents compilation.

package routes

import (
	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// RegisterRoutes wires the application's gin routes.
func RegisterRoutes(r *gin.Engine) {
	r.GET("/v1/orders/:id", GetOrder)
	r.POST("/v1/orders", CreateOrder)
	r.PUT("/v1/orders/:id", UpdateOrder)
	r.PATCH("/v1/orders/:id", PatchOrder)
	r.DELETE("/v1/orders/:id", DeleteOrder)
	r.HEAD("/v1/health", HealthHead)
	r.OPTIONS("/v1/health", HealthOpts)
	r.Any("/v1/wild", WildHandler)
	r.Handle("PROPFIND", "/v1/dav", DavHandler)
	r.GET("/v1/anonymous", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.String(200, "inline")
	})
	r.GET("/v1/with-mw", AuthMiddleware, GetWithMW)

	api := r.Group("/api")
	api.GET("/orders", ListOrders)
}

func GetOrder(c *gin.Context)       {}
func CreateOrder(c *gin.Context)    {}
func UpdateOrder(c *gin.Context)    {}
func PatchOrder(c *gin.Context)     {}
func DeleteOrder(c *gin.Context)    {}
func HealthHead(c *gin.Context)     {}
func HealthOpts(c *gin.Context)     {}
func WildHandler(c *gin.Context)    {}
func DavHandler(c *gin.Context)     {}
func AuthMiddleware(c *gin.Context) {}
func GetWithMW(c *gin.Context)      {}
func ListOrders(c *gin.Context)     {}
